_comment: Gzipped byte budgets for dist/assets/js, enforced by scripts/ci/check-bundle-budget.mjs. eagerJs is what the browser downloads before the entry can run (the entry chunk plus its static import closure). Measured at 431.7 kB on 2026-09-08 and lowered from 454000 to 280000 on 2026-09-09 (US-844), when the Sentry SDK moved behind a dynamic import: 395.6 kB -> 266.6 kB gz, and vendor-sentry left the closure entirely. A budget left above a win is a ceiling, not a ratchet. Measured values and the reasoning are in .ci/bundle-budget.md. Regenerate with --update only for a deliberate, explained change. vendor-supabase was raised from 2932 to 42000 on 2026-09-06: see .ci/bundle-budget.md, the 0.9 kB measurement behind the old number is not reproducible. eagerJs was raised from 280000 to 322000 on 2026-09-10: the 266.6 kB behind the old number was measured on a build with no JWT-shaped VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, which tree-shakes the Supabase client out and shrinks the closure by 39 kB. Every authorized build measures 305.7 kB, so the budget described a bundle that never ships and main ran red for two merges. The check now refuses to generate budgets from such a build and skips the eager comparison on one. preloadedHtml was added on 2026-09-18 (US-816): what each prerendered page tells the browser to preload before it paints, which the eagerJs closure cannot see because those are modulepreload links __vitePreload injected at runtime and the prerenderer froze into the saved HTML. dist/index.html carried 34 of them against app-shell.html's 7; the prerenderer now keeps only what the shell declared, and both measure 188209 gz. Budgeted per page because the two drift. vendor-animation was raised from 41000 to 44000 and vendor-gsap lowered from 62000 to 43000 on 2026-09-18 (US-772): ParallaxBackground moved from GSAP ScrollTrigger to framer-motion useScroll/useTransform, and Landing and EnhancedHero moved their entrance animations to CSS. vendor-gsap measured 58.3 kB gz before and 40.1 kB after, and -- the point of the change -- it is no longer reachable from the landing route at all; only GSAPCalendarMealPlanner and Planner import it now. vendor-animation grew 0.3 kB for the two framer-motion hooks, on a chunk the landing route already loads. index was raised from 124000 to 131000 on 2026-09-18 (US-823): src/lib/webSyncQueue.ts is in the entry chunk because the offline grocery write-queue has to be, and the measured entry chunk is 124.4 kB against the old 124.0. AppContext folds the queue over rows on load and GroceryContext queues every write, so both are mount-time importers -- and moving it behind a dynamic import would fetch a chunk over the network at the exact moment the queue exists to cover, which is when there is no network. Only this one key moved: `--update` rewrites every budget from the current build, which raises ones that are nowhere near their limit and turns a ratchet into a ceiling. The previous 124000 was measured on 2026-09-10 and is the last number that describes a build without this queue.
